title: CP-4 Trust objects v1alpha1
description: Signed objects and trust anchors the engine verifies (identity/crypto.py, artefacts/store.py, core/reconciler.py). See api/trust.v1alpha1.md for the byte-level rules and api/vectors/ for signed test vectors.

Ed25519PublicKey.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

Ed25519Signature.description: base64 of the raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

KeyId.description: 'ed25519:' + first 16 hex chars of sha256(raw public key) (crypto.key_id).

SignatureEnvelope.description: Layer blob (mediaType application/vnd.flex.signature.v1+json) of a release signature manifest. signature = Ed25519 over the exact bytes base64-decoded from payload.

keyid.description: Selects the trusted release key; an unknown keyid = 'untrusted key'.

SafetyApproval.description: Approval proof for safety-relevant releases. The engine installs a safety-relevant deployment only if approved is true and approvers has >= 2 distinct entries.

role.description: Role of the approvers (e.g. safety-engineer); informational on the device.

SignedPayload.description: cosign 'simple signing'-shaped payload. The engine requires critical.image.manifest-digest == the release digest named in the desired state and critical.identity.repository == the repository path.

RequestSignatureHeaders.description: Headers of a signed device request (crypto.sign_request).

X-Flex-Date.description: Unix milliseconds; the cloud accepts +-300 s.

X-Flex-Nonce.description: 12 random bytes, hex; the cloud keeps a bounded replay cache.

TrustAnchors.description: Trust-anchor keys of one device engine's effective configuration (the dict core.reconciler.Engine and cloud.client read; where they sit in the config file is the EV-04 config schema's business).

cloudPublicKey.description: Verifies X-Flex-Manifest-Signature / desired.sig; must equal the onboarding response's cloudPublicKey.

caFile.description: Pinned CA (PEM) for https apiUrl; https without it is refused unless allowSystemTrust.

tlsServerName.description: Hostname to verify instead of the apiUrl host.
